results.content: In this study, we propose a novel two-stage control framework for bipedal walking robots that integrates deep learning-based trajectory planning with a reinforcement learning-based torque controller. In the first section, the results of trajectory planning using deep learning and the control of a bipedal walking robot using deep reinforcement learning are presented. As shown in Fig. 13a–e, the joint angles of the bipedal walking robot exhibit similar periodic behavior for both the dynamic inversion controller and the reinforcement learning controller. As shown in Fig. 15a–e, the angular velocities of the bipedal walking robot exhibit similar periodic behavior for both the inverse dynamics controller and the reinforcement learning controller. Finally, the resistance of the reinforcement learning controller of the bipedal walking robot against disturbances in angular velocities across different step phases is presented in Table 2. This paper demonstrates the efficacy of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) in enhancing the trajectory planning and control of bipedal walking robots, achieving stable and robust walking behavior under uncertainties and external disturbances.
